subject: Seasonal uptick: temporary rate buffer & capacity bump
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@orchidai.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Q3 renewal + capacity bump request

David —

Quick note from OrchidAI ahead of a high-traffic product launch in late August. Our usage is trending ~40% above our current commit for the month of Sept; we expect elevated inference volume through Q3. We want to avoid repeated overage surprises and keep latency predictable for our customers.

As part of our renewal conversation (term ends 10/15), can Redwood: 
- Offer a temporary pricing buffer (hold current rates for 90 days) while we spike?
- Provide a one-time credit to offset the last-quarter overage (~$18k) while we normalize?
- Propose a commit bump option (40% increase) that we can true-up at renewal?

I attached a usage snapshot. Happy to jump on a quick call today.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Ops, OrchidAI
Elena Soto | elena@orchidai.com

Attachment: orchidai-q3-usage-snapshot.csv (CSV, 23KB)

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal + capacity bump request

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can help smooth this spike without disrupting your product launch. High-level proposal (quick) — happy to formalize after a call: 

- Temporary rate buffer: hold your current committed unit price for 90 days (Aug 15–Nov 13) for the bumped volume.
- Commit bump: allow an interim 40% commit increase tied to this window; we would true-up at renewal (10/15) if final usage exceeds the interim commit.
- One-time operational credit: propose a $20,000 credit against last quarter overages (net of invoice adjustments).
- Invoice acceleration option: if you sign the amendment this week we can apply the credit immediately to the Aug invoice and set the rate buffer live the following billing cycle.

I attached a short PDF with the proposed bridge offer and simple term language.

Can we do a 30m call at 11:30 PT? CC'd Marissa for approvals/ops and Ben for any account-level concessions track.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123 | david@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-bridge-offer.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal + capacity bump request

On Wed, Aug 1, 2028 at 9:45 AM David Kim <david@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena —
> 
> Thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can help smooth this spike without disrupting your product launch. High-level proposal (quick) — happy to formalize after a call: 
> 
> - Temporary rate buffer: hold your current committed unit price for 90 days...

Looks reasonable to me. A couple of internal guardrails before we send the final: 
- Keep the credit at $20k (not $25k) — acceptable operational concession; we should make it conditional on signing the amendment by EOD Friday.
- Add a clause: interim commit increase will be capped at 60% of current commit for capacity planning on our end; that keeps scheduling safe.
- Finance needs invoice timing spelled out (Laura, see below).

If Laura signs off I can send the revised redline and approval for Ben to present as the AE offer. 

-Marissa
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-02T14:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal + capacity bump request — finance notes

Marissa/Team —

Thanks for the context. Finance will approve a one-time $20,000 credit provided: 
1) The credit is applied to the next invoice immediately after we receive the signed amendment (DocuSign).
2) Any usage above the interim commit during the buffer window will be billed at the standard overage rate and invoiced monthly; we will not retroactively apply the credit to additional overages.
3) The interim commit cap is 60% as discussed; if OrchidAI requests more than 60% we will treat that as a separate capacity request and route to capacity planning (possible staggered provisioning).

Once the signed amendment is in place, update billing codes and we’ll send a one-line credit memo.

-Laura 
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-02T16:03:00Z
Subject: Final: 90-day buffer + 60% interim commit cap (amendment attached)

Elena —

Appreciate the quick discussion earlier. Per our internal approvals, here is the revised offer: 

- 90-day temporary rate buffer: your current committed per-unit price will be held for the bumped volume between Aug 15 and Nov 13.
- Interim commit increase: capped at 60% above current commit for capacity reasons; this interim commit will be reconciled at renewal (10/15).
- One-time credit: $20,000 applied to the next invoice immediately after we receive the signed amendment.
- Overages during the buffer window beyond the interim commit will be billed at standard overage rates and will not be covered by the one-time credit.
- Condition: amendment signed via DocuSign by EOD Friday, 2028-08-04.

Attaching the redline amendment (simple two-paragraph addendum). If you agree we’ll send the DocuSign link and set billing live once executed.

Best,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline-amendment.docx (DOCX, 12KB)
Related link: https://docusign.com/sign/ABC123

From: Elena Soto <elena@orchidai.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@orchidai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-03T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Final: 90-day buffer + 60% interim commit cap (amendment attached)

David/Team —

Thanks — OrchidAI accepts the revised terms. We signed via the DocuSign link this morning. Please confirm when the credit appears and when the interim commit is active (we need the provisioning window aligned with our load test schedule).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will make the launch much less risky.

Elena Soto
Head of Platform Ops, OrchidAI
